provenance.headline: OFFICIAL — the ARVC rasters as delivered by SMAMUS.
provenance.received: 2026-08-11, from SMAMUS (Secretaria Municipal do Meio Ambiente, Urbanismo e Sustentabilidade), Prefeitura Municipal de Porto Alegre.
provenance.source_document: P3 — Análise de Riscos e Vulnerabilidade Climáticas, Plano de Ação Climática de Porto Alegre (2023)
provenance.source_authors: WayCarbon, ICLEI América do Sul, Ludovino Lopes Advogados, Ecofinance
provenance.commissioned_by: Banco Mundial / Prefeitura Municipal de Porto Alegre
provenance.scenario: SSP3-7.0 (CMIP6 AR6). GCM ensemble: MIROC6, MRI-ESM2-0, NorESM2-MM, GFDL-ESM4, ACCESS-ESM1-5, IPSL-CM6A-LR. Windows: historical 1995–2014, 2030 = 2021–2040, 2050 = 2041–2060.
provenance.method: R = ∛(ameaça × exposição × vulnerabilidade), per IPCC AR5/AR6. Reproduced from the delivered A/E/V rasters to a mean absolute error of 0.0035 (r = 0.997), so the components and the composite are mutually consistent.
provenance.attribution: Prefeitura Municipal de Porto Alegre / SMAMUS — Plano de Ação Climática, produto P3 (WayCarbon, ICLEI, Ludovino Lopes Advogados, Ecofinance)
